scope: Bounded current working-oracle adaptation of superseded viewport corner/height and exact source pins only. All original mathematical graph, relation, source-body, endpoint, shape and projection assertions remain. Immutable49feoracle and d75receipt are preserved; new32-case viewport oracle independently accepts current card behavior.

inverse_replacements.old_literal: assert data["beforeScroll"]==data["afterScroll"] and data["scrollEnd"]==[660,1600] and data["scrollHome"]==[0,0]
inverse_replacements.new_literal:
assert data["beforeScroll"] == data["afterScroll"]
    # Home/End now reveal real cards rather than the superseded empty SVG corner.
    v = data["scrollView"]
    xy = positions(v)
    cards = [(n, xy[n["id"]], n["cardHeight"]) for n in v["nodes"]]
    last = max(cards, key=lambda row: row[1][1] + row[2] / 2)
    first = min(cards, key=lambda row: (row[1][1] - row[2] / 2, row[1][0]))
    width, height = data["scrollMetrics"]
    for (n, (x, y), h), (left, top) in [(last, data["scrollEnd"]), (first, data["scrollHome"])]:
        half_width = 7 if n["kind"] == "unit_dot" else 92
        assert left <= x - half_width and x + half_width <= left + width
        assert top <= y - h / 2 and y + h / 2 <= top + height

source=(ROOT/path).read_bytes()
